build_dialogue_safety_data: call build(datapath) to download single and multi turn dialogue safety datasets
download_single_turn_safety: download the single turn safety JSON dataset using the RESOURCES list
download_multi_turn_safety: download the multi turn safety JSON dataset using the RESOURCES list

remove_outdated_data: remove older versions of the dialogue safety data directory before rebuilding
